title: Analyzing and Mitigating Cross-Lingual Degradation in Multilingual Medical VQA
abstract: arXiv:2608.22363v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medical visual question answering (VQA) is a crucial task in clinical AI, yet its evaluation has so far centered almost exclusively on English, limiting its relevance to linguistically diverse patients and clinicians. Recent multilingual medical VQA benchmarks show that large vision-language models (LVLMs) degrade in non-English languages, but lack a fine-grained analysis of how cross-lingual variation affects the distinct capabilities that medical VQA requires. To this end, we construct a multilingual medical VQA benchmark over eight languages, organized into four representative scenarios that isolate the core capabilities medical VQA requires. Evaluating five open- and closed-source LVLMs, we find that cross-lingual degradation is not uniform but highly scenario-dependent. translated_title: 多语言医学视觉问答中的跨语言性能下降分析与缓解
translated_abstract: 医学视觉问答（VQA）是临床人工智能中的关键任务，然而其评估迄今为止几乎完全集中在英语上，限制了其对语言多样化的患者和临床医生的实用性。最近的多语言医学VQA基准显示，大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在非英语语言中性能下降，但缺乏对跨语言变异如何影响医学VQA所需的不同能力的细粒度分析。为此，我们构建了一个涵盖八种语言的多语言医学VQA基准，并组织为四个代表性场景，以隔离医学VQA所需的核心能力。通过评估五个开源和闭源LVLMs，我们发现跨语言性能下降并非均匀分布，而是高度依赖场景。因此，我们提出了MedVL-XLRepE，一种无需训练、场景感知的表示工程方法，利用LVLMs在英语医学VQA中的优越能力来引导缓解跨语言退化。
tldr: 本研究构建了一个八语言医学VQA基准，揭示跨语言退化具有场景依赖性，并提出无需训练的MedVL-XLRepE方法，利用英文能力引导缓解多语言性能下降。
en_tdlr: This work constructs an eight-language medical VQA benchmark, reveals that cross-lingual degradation is scenario-dependent, and proposes a training-free method MedVL-XLRepE that leverages English capability to mitigate multilingual performance drops.
